instruction: Riga 412, prima frase della Discussione. Non mettere cifre di speedup in questa frase: restano nei Risultati (Table 4 e frase sul peso del DE, traccia T3).

instruction: Riga 413. Sostituire con: "The spatial benchmark, repeated with a fresh process per repeat and the same cell groups on CPU and GPU, gave end-to-end speedups of 1.4x (Visium v1), 6.9x (Visium HD 8 um, co-occurrence excluded) and 10.4x (Visium HD 2 um) against the 100-CPU DGX reference; among spatial-specific operations only spatial autocorrelation gained substantially, and GPU co-occurrence at Visium HD 8 um was incorrect in rapids-singlecell 0.14.1." Accanto ai valori di riferimento scrivere quelli del controllo sul server (1.6x, 6.1x, 9.4x), come chiede S5.md.
